items.summary: Generate a new pixel-art style Home page background image depicting a playground landscape with pets playing in the distance (no UI text embedded in the image). Store it as a static asset under frontend/public/assets/generated and ensure it can be referenced from React via a stable public path.

Apply the new playground landscape background to the Home (session setup) screen in a way that preserves readability and the existing pixel-desktop theme. The background must not interfere with interactions (forms/buttons) and must not obscure the persistent PetOverlay when a session is active.

Make the app end-to-end functional by ensuring the complete flow works without runtime errors for both authenticated and unauthenticated states: login (Internet Identity) → profile setup (if missing) → start session → focus timer → transition to break → save completed session to backend → view session history in Progress, with graceful handling when the user is not logged in (no unauthorized traps causing a broken UI).

Use saved user settings (focus duration, break duration, wasted platforms) to prefill and synchronize the Home/Setup experience and distraction check-ins, so the default configuration is consistent across Home and Progress Settings.
